tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_start_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_office_step value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_pending_event
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_holding_treasury_disposition
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_holding_garrison_disposition
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_holding_chancery_disposition
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_holding_waterworks_disposition
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_holding_endowment_disposition
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_legitimacy_score value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_efficiency_score value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_extraction_score value = 0 }
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_completed
}

tv_wonder_alhambra_advance_office_step_effect = {

}

# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_fire_office_event_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_fire_office_event_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_office_step ?= 0  tv_wonder_alhambra_war_validated_trigger = yes }

		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1686 days = 1 }

		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_office_step ?= 1 }

tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {

}

# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_apply_reckoning_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_apply_reckoning_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_alhambra_legitimacy_score >= var:tv_wonder_alhambra_efficiency_score
			var:tv_wonder_alhambra_legitimacy_score >= var:tv_wonder_alhambra_extraction_score
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path value = 1 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_efficiency_score >= var:tv_wonder_alhambra_extraction_score }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path value = 2 }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path value = 3 }
		add_prestige = -3
	}
	tv_wonder_alhambra_advance_office_step_effect = yes
}

# -- tv_wonder_alhambra_grant_final_reward_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_alhambra_grant_final_reward_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path ?= 1 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_concord_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		location:granada = {
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_concord_location_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		}
		add_prestige = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_alhambra_dominant_path ?= 2 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_administration_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		location:granada = {
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_administration_location_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		}
		add_prestige = 8
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_extraction_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		location:granada = {
			add_location_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_alhambra_palace_extraction_location_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		}
		add_prestige = 3
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_alhambra_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_alhambra_advance_office_step_effect = yes
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}
